openInvoices.description:
Counts/bools are cast explicitly so the generated spec publishes
integer/boolean rather than falling back to `string` — the mobile
client decodes against the spec.

creditAvailable.description:
'issued' only — same filter Tenant::outstandingBalance() uses for
spendable credit (applied/void notes carry no remaining balance).

password.description: Must differ from the current one and be confirmed.

leaseId.description:
Lease must belong to this tenant. The percentage-rent check and
duplicate-period check carry richer messages and live in the
action; here we just establish ownership.

attachments.description:
The tenant no longer types a figure — they attach their sales
report and staff read the number off it, then lock to bill the
percentage rent. At least one file is required. Mirrors the
maintenance upload (images + PDF, ≤10 MB each, ≤5 files). Using
mimetypes (not mimes) validates the real content type, so a
renamed .mp4 can't slip through as a .jpg.

category.description:
Sub-category is required for types that define one (maintenance,
access, document, complaint) and validated against that type's set;
types without sub-categories (inquiry, billing) must NOT send one
(`prohibited` → 422 if they do, so no cross-type value is persisted).

unitId.description:
If supplied, the unit must belong to one of THIS tenant's leases.
Prevents a tenant from filing against someone else's unit. When
omitted, the service derives it from the active lease.

attachments.description:
Optional photos / PDFs of the issue. Mirrors the portal upload
(images + PDF only, ≤10 MB each, ≤5 files) so what a tenant can
attach from the app matches what staff can attach in the admin.
mimetypes (not mimes) validates the real content type, so a
renamed .mp4 can't slip through as a .jpg.

invoice.description:
The invoice this credit was raised against (null for standalone
tenant-level credits). Only present when eager-loaded.

createdAt.description:
The raw push token is deliberately not echoed back — it is a
write-only credential from the client's perspective.

creditAppliedAmount.description: Portion of paid_amount covered by applied credit notes (vs cash).

paymentLinkUrl.description:
Shareable public pay link (no login) — null once nothing is owed.
Lets the app surface a "share payment link" alongside in-app pay.

etaStatus.description:
ETA (Egyptian Tax Authority) e-invoice references — present once
the invoice has been accepted by the ETA portal. Useful for the
app to show a "tax-registered" badge.

items.description: Relations — only present on the detail endpoint (eager-loaded).

type.description:
UUID
Short class name (e.g. "PaymentReceivedNotification") so the app can
branch on it without coupling to the PHP namespace.

data.description:
Notification payload, minus the Filament bell render hints — those
are server-side presentation cruft the mobile app shouldn't see (and
stripping them keeps this from silently shipping internal keys).

channel.description: How the payment was taken: payment_link / mobile_api / portal / admin.

receiptAt.description: When the captured-payment receipt fired (null until captured).

allocations.description:
Per-invoice allocation. A single payment can clear several
invoices; each row carries how much of this payment landed on
that invoice (the invoice_payment.allocated_amount pivot value).

category.description:
The type's sub-category (electrical, parking, lease_copy…); null
for types that have none (inquiry, billing query).

canCancel.description:
Whether the tenant may still cancel — true only before staff
start work. Mirrors the cancel endpoint's guard so the app can
show/hide the button without a round-trip.

canRate.description:
Whether the tenant can submit a satisfaction rating — true once the
request is resolved/closed. Mirrors the rate endpoint's guard.

attachments.description:
Attachments uploaded by tenant or staff (Spatie media library,
`attachments` collection). Absolute URLs so the app can render
images / open PDFs directly. Only images + PDF are accepted on
upload, so the app never receives a type it can't preview.

id.description:
id + size are cast explicitly: the media model's props are
untyped, so Scramble published them as `string` while the
wire carried ints — the client decoded `as String` and
threw, taking the whole request list down with it.

url.description: Authenticated, tenant-scoped stream — NOT a public URL (H2).

taxId.description:
Deliberately re-exposed despite Tenant::$hidden. Mobile invoice
displays + ETA submissions need it; national_id stays hidden
(more sensitive PII). Confirmed at audit M02 F-7 / D-5.

declaredSales.description:
Null until staff review the attached report and enter the figure;
the app should show "Pending review" rather than 0.

attachments.description:
The tenant's uploaded sales report (Spatie `sales_report`
collection). Absolute, authenticated, tenant-scoped stream URLs —
NOT public (the file can carry commercial turnover figures).

UpdateProfileRequest.description:
Tenant self-service profile edit. Deliberately narrow: only contact fields
the tenant owns. name / legal_name / email / status / tax_id / national_id
are admin-managed and NOT editable here (audit M02 F-9).
